::: {#about-block}
## Websites, dashboards and workshops for research teams

__We turn research data into tools people use every day, built in R.__

We build:

- __websites__, for scheduling visits or keeping an eye on your data
- __interactive dashboards__, to explore and analyze your data flexibly
- __applications__, for gathering and analyzing data in real time
- __automated data pipelines__, from collecting data to visualizing patterns

We also offer:

- __statistical analyses__, to find patterns in data and plan interventions
- __data visualization__, to make complex patterns easy to see
- __data workshops__, with hands-on training in analysis and visualization

:::
